sourceReceipts.contentRelevance: The six responsible-AI principles and practical fairness, privacy, accessibility, transparency, and accountability measures. Principles describe design goals. They do not prove global product availability or guarantee that all risks have been removed.

sourceReceipts.title: Mitigate AI risks
sourceReceipts.contentRelevance: AI opacity, biased outcomes, privacy risk, and governance plus human oversight as mitigation. General risk-management principles rather than assurances about any particular Copilot deployment.

sourceReceipts.title: Application card: GitHub Copilot inline suggestions
sourceReceipts.contentRelevance: Inline suggestion lifecycle, cursor/open-file context, explicit acceptance, model limitations, code matching, and review requirements. Use behavior and limitations, not the contradictory plan banner or broad natural-language scope wording. Internal evaluation descriptions are not selected as claim authority.

sourceReceipts.title: Application card: GitHub Copilot Chat
sourceReceipts.contentRelevance: Chat input processing, surface-specific context, BYOK data considerations, incomplete or inaccurate outputs, and on-demand PR summaries with a large-file limit. Approve only claim-inventory sections covering Chat context, output validation, PR summaries, and provider data scope. Do not infer product availability, legal ownership, or fixed retention from this application card.

sourceReceipts.title: About GitHub Copilot CLI
sourceReceipts.contentRelevance: Standalone CLI interactive/programmatic modes, context management, heuristic trusted-directory boundaries, and allow/deny tool permissions. Use stable CLI modes and permission semantics in the inventory. First-party cloud/local sandboxes are Public Preview and not used by these claims. No blanket model-window size or assurance of security isolation is approved.

sourceReceipts.title: Managing GitHub Copilot policies as an individual subscriber
sourceReceipts.contentRelevance: Public-code matching controls, inherited organizational settings, and individual versus Business/Enterprise model-training settings. Public-code Block mode applies only where supported. Data claims are scoped to plan and current policy, not blanket retention or legal guarantees.

sourceReceipts.title: GitHub Copilot user prompt process flow
sourceReceipts.contentRelevance: Conceptual inbound/outbound prompt flow, HTTPS transmission, cursor context, fill-in-the-middle, and a proxy stage. Only selected conceptual flow claims. Do not claim all PII is removed, filters guarantee secure code, accepted suggestions immediately train models, or public matching has a universal length threshold.

sourceReceipts.title: GitHub Copilot data
sourceReceipts.contentRelevance: Finite context windows motivate focused requests and relevant snippets. Approved only for the qualitative finite-context principle. Reject obsolete fixed 4k context, 200–500 line windows, blanket prompt discard, and 28-day retention generalizations.

sourceReceipts.title: Content exclusion for GitHub Copilot
sourceReceipts.contentRelevance: Business/Enterprise exclusion behavior, supported-mode limitations, indirect semantic information, symlinks, remote filesystems, and policy lookup. Inventory uses GA local supported IDE inline/Chat behavior only. GitHub website and Mobile exclusions are explicitly Public Preview. Editor Edit/Agent modes are unsupported. Icon-only support-matrix cells are not evidence.
